Name: (FS) Yeon Yi's Simple Makeup
Author: Babeyeonyi
Description:
[center][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][/size][/font][/center][center][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]﻿୨୧------------------------------------------------------------------------୨୧
Hello! This mod adds a collection of simple makeup: blush, lipstick and eyeliner as accessories!
Blush has 4 versions: Pink, Orange, Dark, Dyeable
Eyeliner has 4 versions: Black, Brown, Soft Brown, Dyeable
Lipstick has 5 versions: Pink, Orange, Red, Dark, Dyeable
And you can use blush, eyeliner, lipstick at the same time! This mod allows you to customize your makeup fully!
Hope you enjoy this mod! ☆*: .｡. o(≧▽≦)o .｡.:*☆
﻿୨୧------------------------------------------------------------------------୨୧
